notes.title: Demo Coming June – No One Leaves the Field Steam Page Now Live
notes.notes:
[b]🌾 No One Leaves the Field – Steam Page is Live![/b]

We’ve officially launched the Steam page for No One Leaves the Field—our upcoming first-person folk horror game.

You wake up in a twisted wheat field after a crash, your keys missing... and something is lurking in the stalks. Every time you try to escape, the maze changes. Every step off the path brings the scarecrow closer.

🕯️ A demo is coming for Steam Next Fest this June.

🎮 Wishlist the game and be among the first to enter the field:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652690/No_One_Leaves_the_Field/

Thanks for joining us on this eerie little journey. We can’t wait to show you more.

#NoOneLeavesTheField #IndieHorror #SteamNextFest #DigitalSagas

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Log – Our New Horror Game Has Begun!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve officially started development on our next game: No One Leaves the Fields — a slow-burning first-person horror game set on a remote farm surrounded by ever-shifting wheat fields. At night. With… something else out there.

In this week’s dev log, we talk about: 🌾 Procedural wheat field generation
🏚️ Our first haunted farmhouse prototype
💡 Night lighting experiments
🎮 Our approach to building tension slowly

If you're into atmospheric horror and quiet dread, you’ll want to follow along.

👉 Read the full post here:
https://digitalsagas.com/f/dev-log-%E2%80%93-april-6-2025-into-the-fields?blogcategory=Dev+Blog

Thanks for being here. More soon!

— The Digital Sagas Team
#JoinTheSaga

notes.title: Space Exploration Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130899/e051f27c6c5cca5d6f784c5a0eca485478560615.png[/img]

Lost Colony is currently participating in the Space Exploration Fest. This will be your last chance to play the current demo. 

Any Feedback is appreciated and will help shape the game. From the updated Trailer, some of the updates like enemy hit feedback, mini-map and the dash mechanic (teleport swap with AIDA) are all due to feedback from players. 
Additional updates are in the works, like an upgrade system and power ups for AIDA. I will add these features to future videos and eventually a new Demo with all the new mechanics will be release.

Be on the look out for option to opt in to play test early versions of the new Demo as well.

Thank you
Jaime Sanchez
Executive Director, Digital Sagas LLC

notes.title: Indie Playtest Fest
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that “Lost Colony” will be showcased at the Indie Playtest Fest, beginning August 1st! 🎉 Dive into our demo, share your valuable feedback, and stand a chance to win amazing prizes!

🌟 Why Participate?

Discover Unique Games: Play a variety of indie titles, including our demo, and experience fresh gameplay.
Provide Feedback: Your insights are crucial in helping us refine “Lost Colony.”
Win Prizes: Play and share your feedback for a chance to enter festival raffles! 🎁✨

🎁 Special Prize Details:
Four raffle winners will be selected to receive Steam gift cards:
1 winner of a $50 Steam gift card
1 winner of a $25 Steam gift card
2 winners of a $10 Steam gift card
[url=https://digitalsagas.com/indie-playtest-fest-1]Click here for more details[/url]

🔍 How to Get Involved:

Play the Demo: Starting August 1st, dive into “Lost Colony” and explore our universe.
Give Us Your Feedback: Your thoughts are invaluable for our development.
Enter the Raffles: Every playthrough gives you a shot at winning fantastic prizes!
Mark your calendars and get ready to join the Indie Playtest Fest! We can’t wait to see you there and hear what you think. 🌌

👉 Play the Demo Starting August 1st! 👈

Thank you for your support, and see you at the fest! 🚀🌟
Raffle entries need to be submitted by August 22nd 2024.
